messages.subject: saving workspace error
parts:
Hello,
when R closes and I ask to save workspace I get the message:
[ cannot open compressed file ".RDataTmp" probable reason "Permision denied"  ]
 
But I canr fine this file .RDataTmp!
where should it be?
 
Thank you
Ronen

messages.author: a305e65fa9dfb74d
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] saving workspace error
parts:
My guess is that you are using windows, launching R with the start menu icon. 
This will start R in the binary's/executable's directory, which is probably not in a directory you have writing privileges in.

I would try changing the working directory before closing, or staring R by clicking on an .R or .Rdata file (that will set the working directory to the one where the file resides).

Does this help?
